start_here: Install Python 3.10+, Node.js 18+ and Git. Run python -B tools/dev.py from the repository root. jq 1.7.1 is optional for the jq test.

commands.windows_python_alias: Use py -3 in place of python if needed.
commands.mac_linux_python_alias: Use python3 in place of python if needed.

layout.tools: All build/translation tools, source templates and regression tests.
layout.scripts: Published remote runtimes. Fitness+ script is stable; F1 runtime is an unconfirmed experiment.
layout.loon: Published stable and F1 experimental subscriptions. Never overwrite these by running a base generator.
layout.config/release.json: Public profiles and immutable remote runtime URLs used to reproduce releases.
layout.vendor/pinned: Exact upstream scripts for 114 referenced commit/path pairs, checked by SHA-256 when Git history is absent.
layout.vendor/pinned-manifest.json: Checksums for pinned sources. No separate clone of original Git history required.
layout.vendor/upstream-snapshot.json: Upstream source attribution, snapshot revision and checksums.
layout.payloads: Full upstream payload source snapshot; includes recorded real HLS master structure used in regression tests.
layout.subtitles: Published Chinese M3U8/VTT resources, not embedded in plugin.
layout.examples: Synthetic samples and nonfunctional .test domain config templates.
layout.tests/fixtures: Sanitized clear caption packets and timestamps only. No original media/headers/credentials.
layout.local/catalog.json: Empty custom program catalog; keep private material under ignored local/.
layout.build: Ignored generated base and release artifacts.

requirements.jq: optional; tests were run with jq 1.7.1
requirements.deepseek_key: Set only in Loon plugin arguments; not needed by offline tests.

fitness_flow: Keep original English track. Add zh-Hans based on donor metadata: AUTOSELECT=YES and original accessibility CHARACTERISTICS.
Add __loon_fitness_zh=1 to original HLS subtitle URLs. Let AVPlayer fetch natively; RESPONSE scripts rewrite playlists and translate VTT cue text.
Translation has its own 2-15s deadline (default 8s). Return original English response on failure. Store successful translations in 128 local cache slots.
Never reintroduce long request-script download/retry loops; those stalled training startup.
f1_flow_and_limits: Generic F1 OnDemand detection uses UTS league metadata, not a race-specific asset allowlist.
Register source locally and rewrite only hlsUrl to hls-amt master bridge. Leave FairPlay certificate/license URLs untouched.
Do not add linear.tv.apple.com or play-edge.itunes.apple.com to MITM. The first host also carries FairPlay license traffic.
Master bridge GET has a four-second hard deadline; redirect to original native source on failure.
For recorded English CC1 CatchUp fragmented MP4, read clear GA94 CEA-608 packets without decrypting or modifying video. Use sample timing to construct WebVTT.
Use one low-bitrate caption source per CDN pathway. Translate sidecar cue text only; video responses never wait for translation.
This is not verified to cover CEA-708-only, other CDN formats, actual live streams, or all F1 replays.
Current computer could not fetch the actual linear main playlist; reconstructed recorded upstream master structure and real captured clear CC packets were tested.
release_workflow: Edit tools/fitness_deepseek.js or tools/f1_cc608.js + tools/f1_cc_runtime.js. Keep stable and experimental behavior separate.
Run python -B tools/dev.py. Outputs stay under build/. --check-published will intentionally fail after source changes until the corresponding runtime is regenerated.
Copy only the changed compiled runtime from build/scripts/ to scripts/, commit it, then set its immutable commit URL in config/release.json.
Rebuild the plugins into build/, compare intended changes, copy selected output into loon/ and commit. Do not automatically promote experimental F1 to stable.
Run offline checks again. Push explicit commits to julianaexx/apple-video-subtitles only.
Verify every published URL returns HTTP 200 and matches git show <commit>:<path>. Document actual phone feedback in this JSON, not as a claim inferred from mocks.
upstream_refresh: Get a separate full checkout of rexchen1803/apple-video-subtitles. It is a different repository/history; do not merge it blindly into this main branch.
Review and copy desired updated upstream payloads/client modules. Record the new upstream revision in vendor/upstream-snapshot.json.
Run python -B tools/bundle_upstream.py /path/to/upstream-checkout to refresh fixed-commit dependencies referenced by the current Surge module.
Review data shape changes reported by generator; rerun tests, rebuild and review the stable/experimental plugin diff before publishing.
private_material_not_published: Original ZIP captures, signed playback URLs, request headers/cookies, API keys, local translation model/runtime downloads, and computer paths.
Private raw-capture regression is optional. Sanitized fixtures allow CC decoder work on a fresh clone.

user_preferences: One plugin import. Remote scripts/subtitles may be downloaded by Loon.
No subtitle bodies or API credentials inside the plugin.
Keep user GitHub free of Markdown; use this JSON as the development handoff.
Fitness+ and unlisted F1 replay support must be generic, not restricted to one class/race.
Do not require the user to break working playback just to collect diagnostics; state what is and is not established by available evidence.
